profile.headline: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) | Active Secret Clearance
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Tony Chiesa.

My vision is to help engineering organizations build software faster, more reliably, and with far less friction by enabling teams to operate at a higher level of efficiency and confidence.

I’m extremely fortunate that I get to solve complex technical problems every day at the intersection of software engineering, automation, and infrastructure, where I can have a real impact on how teams deliver mission-critical software.

My background as an Automated Test Engineer has given me experience in CI/CD pipelines, scalable test infrastructure, Docker-based orchestration, and DevSecOps practices. I’ve led projects involving parallel test orchestration, containerized execution environments, testing analytics dashboards, and modern pipeline optimization.

The people I serve are developers, testers, and engineering organizations that need confidence in their software delivery process. When the work goes well, teams release software faster, pipelines become more stable, bottlenecks are reduced, and engineering organizations can scale more effectively.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Experienced Software Engineer in Test specializing in the implementation and optimization of automated testing for mission-critical systems. Proven ability to develop scalable solutions using Python, Jenkins, Docker, and VMware, with a focus on integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines within a DevSecOps environment.

Key Contributions:
	•	Containerized Jenkins test execution using Docker, enabling parallelization and reducing overall pipeline runtime by more than 50%, accelerating test feedback cycles and boosting team productivity.
	•	Developed and automated over 250 integration and functional test cases, driving an increase of 50,000+ hours of automated testing annually and expanding mission-critical system coverage.
	•	Engineered an Automated Test Suite, in a classified environment, mirroring the official Software Integration (SWI) qualification suite, delivering realistic, repeatable test execution and laying the foundation for direct integration into the qualification pipeline.
	•	Created a CI/CD dashboard with trend analysis and health monitoring, adding daily and monthly filters that significantly improved visibility into pipeline stability and streamlined troubleshooting.
positions.insights: Automated Software Testing, Python (Programming Language) and +3 skills

positions.title: PHP Web Developer
positions.description:
PHP Developer skilled in building and maintaining web applications using PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and working in MVC frameworks. Strong track record of upgrading legacy systems, resolving technical issues, and delivering scalable, high-quality code for SaaS platforms.

•	Developed and maintained SaaS products using PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML/CSS, and RESTful APIs, delivering enhanced features and user functionality.
	•	Successfully led the migration of multiple legacy systems from PHP 7.4 to PHP 8.1, improving system performance, security, and maintainability while adopting modern language features.
	•	Diagnosed and resolved software bugs and performance issues with a hands-on, detail-oriented approach, resulting in faster load times and reduced downtime across client-facing applications.
	•	Managed regular codebase upgrades and website enhancements within an MVC architecture, adhering to best practices for scalability, maintainability, and clean code.
	•	Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, translating technical requirements into business-aligned deliverables, and contributing across both frontend and backend development pipelines.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
As a freelance web developer, I designed and developed custom websites and web applications for small businesses and individual clients using PHP, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and full-stack web apps using the MERN framework, resulting in improved user engagement and business visibility.

• Integrated third-party APIs (e.g., Stripe, Google Maps, Mailchimp) and secure payment gateways, enabling full-service ecommerce and lead-generation capabilities.
• Implemented SEO best practices, performance tuning, and basic security hardening, leading to higher search rankings and reduced bounce rates for clients.
• Managed the full project lifecycle — from requirements gathering and wireframing to deployment and support — ensuring client satisfaction and on-time delivery across all projects.

projects.title: Android-Invintory-App
projects.description:
The goal of this application is to be used to track items in a warehouse. To meet user needs this application includes the following:

A database with at least two tables, one to store the inventory items and one to store user logins and passwords
A screen for logging into the app. Note that this should also be used to create a login if the user has never logged in before.
A screen, with a grid, that displays all items in the inventory
A mechanism by which the user can add and remove items from inventory
A mechanism by which the user can increase or decrease the number of a specific item in the inventory
A mechanism by which the application will notify the user when the amount of any item in the inventory has been reduced to 0 (zero)

projects.title: NBA Historical Data Analysis | MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js
projects.description: This is a full-stack MERN application that is performing some mathematical analysis of historical data from the NBA. Some of the technologies I use in this project are Chart.js, a stats model npm package, and react-bootstrap.
